name: kitabh
description: Analyze your Kitabh newsletter, articles and subscribers in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Kitabh is an Arabic platform for newsletters and long-form writing. This plugin lets a Kitabh writer analyze their own newsletter in ChatGPT: which articles were read the most, email open and click rates per issue, subscriber growth over time, unsubscribe patterns, comment activity and the best days to publish. Answers are based on the writer's own newsletters, articles, email results, followers and subscriber engagement. Writers can also save a new draft, and mark subscriber addresses that keep bouncing so they stop receiving email. Each writer can only access their own data. Requires a Kitabh account.
defaultPrompt: Which of my Kitabh articles got the most views?
How did my Kitabh newsletter subscribers grow over the last six months?
ما أفضل يوم لنشر مقالاتي في كتابة؟

positive.prompt: Which newsletters do I have on Kitabh and how many subscribers does each have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the newsletter «دفتر التجربة» with about 1,240 subscribers, 12 articles and its email activity.

positive.prompt: Which of my Kitabh articles got the most views?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the articles ranked by views, led by «لماذا نكتب في زمن السرعة؟» with 4,820 views.

positive.prompt: How did my newsletter subscribers grow over the last six months?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows monthly new subscribers from May to October 2026 and the running total reaching about 1,240.

positive.prompt: What are my email open and click rates, and which articles had the best open rate?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports overall open and click rates and ranks articles by email open rate.

positive.description: Save a draft (demo account simulates it)
positive.prompt: Create a draft in Kitabh titled "Notes for next issue" with three bullet points about my best-performing topics.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_draft with the title and content; the review account replies that the draft was simulated and nothing was saved. Nothing is published.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my newsletter subscribers.

negative.description: Another writer's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the subscriber list of another writer's newsletter on Kitabh.
Publish my latest draft on Kitabh right now.

publication.release_notes: First release: read analytics for Kitabh newsletters, articles, email performance and subscribers; save drafts.

ar-SA.subtitle: نشرتك بالأرقام
ar-SA.description: اربط حسابك في كتابة واسأل ChatGPT عن نشرتك: أي مقالاتك قُرئ أكثر، ومعدلات فتح بريدك والنقر عليه، ونمو مشتركيك، وأنماط إلغاء الاشتراك، وأفضل أيام النشر. الإجابات من بياناتك أنت. ويمكنك أيضًا حفظ مسودة جديدة. كل كاتب يصل إلى بياناته فقط.
